title: ABOUT US
subtitle: Tradition • Culture • Celebration
lead: Rooted in Tradition. Inspired by Culture. Driven by Excellence.
paragraphs: SANSKRITI is a celebration of India's rich cultural heritage, timeless traditions and the spirit of togetherness.

Inspired by the beauty of Indian customs, values and artistic traditions, SANSKRITI is dedicated to creating meaningful experiences that bring people closer and turn special occasions into unforgettable memories.
We believe every celebration has a story, every tradition has a meaning, and every moment deserves to be cherished.
From traditional celebrations and cultural festivals to weddings, grand events, entertainment and special occasions, we bring creativity, dedication and perfection to everything we do.
Our vision is to preserve the essence of our cultural heritage while embracing modern ideas, creating celebrations that connect generations and leave lasting impressions.
closing: SANSKRITI - Where Tradition Meets Celebration, and Every Moment Becomes a Memory.
motto: Celebrating Traditions. Connecting Generations. Creating Timeless Memories.
